FROM (SELECT wait_id, 'original' AS via, tpl_deferral AS tpl, branch_deferral AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'latest' AS via, tpl_now AS tpl, branch_now AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits) c
JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = c.wait_id
JOIN (SELECT wait_id, 'unstable' AS kind, concat('unstable ships ', version) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now
        WHERE release = 'sid' AND status = 'fixed' AND version <> '0'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'release_tag' AS kind, concat('fix commit in release tag ', split(release_tags, ',')[0], ': ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND release_tags <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'commit' AS kind, concat('fix commit exists: ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND commit_exists = '1'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'pr_merged' AS kind, concat('PR merged ', merged_at, ': ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_pull' AND merged_at <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'branch' AS kind, concat('fix on release/', branch, ': ', tags) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix
        WHERE met = '1') ev ON ev.wait_id = c.wait_id

      SELECT wait_id, 'release_tag' AS kind, concat('fix commit in release tag ', split(release_tags, ',')[0], ': ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream

      UNION ALL

        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND commit_exists = '1'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'pr_merged' AS kind, concat('PR merged ', merged_at, ': ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream

      UNION ALL

FROM (SELECT wait_id, 'original' AS via, tpl_deferral AS tpl, branch_deferral AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'latest' AS via, tpl_now AS tpl, branch_now AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits) c
JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = c.wait_id
JOIN (SELECT wait_id, 'unstable' AS kind, concat('unstable ships ', version) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now
        WHERE release = 'sid' AND status = 'fixed' AND version <> '0'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'release_tag' AS kind, concat('fix commit in release tag ', split(release_tags, ',')[0], ': ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND release_tags <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'commit' AS kind, concat('fix commit exists: ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND commit_exists = '1'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'pr_merged' AS kind, concat('PR merged ', merged_at, ': ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_pull' AND merged_at <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'branch' AS kind, concat('fix on release/', branch, ': ', tags) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix

WHERE (c.tpl = 'upstream_fix' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag'))

      SELECT wait_id, 'latest' AS via, tpl_now AS tpl, branch_now AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits) c

        WHERE release = 'sid' AND status = 'fixed' AND version <> '0'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'release_tag' AS kind, concat('fix commit in release tag ', split(release_tags, ',')[0], ': ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND release_tags <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'commit' AS kind, concat('fix commit exists: ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND commit_exists = '1'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'pr_merged' AS kind, concat('PR merged ', merged_at, ': ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_pull' AND merged_at <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'branch' AS kind, concat('fix on release/', branch, ': ', tags) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix
        WHERE met = '1') ev ON ev.wait_id = c.wait_id

CREATE SCHEMASTORE VIEW reopen_due WITH CONTAINER rv3 AS SELECT w.wait_id, w.cve, w.pkg, w.deferred_at, w.condition_at_deferral, w.condition_now, c.via, c.tpl, ev.kind, ev.detail
FROM (SELECT wait_id, 'original' AS via, tpl_deferral AS tpl, branch_deferral AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'latest' AS via, tpl_now AS tpl, branch_now AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits) c
JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = c.wait_id
JOIN (SELECT wait_id, 'unstable' AS kind, concat('unstable ships ', version) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now
        WHERE release = 'sid' AND status = 'fixed' AND version <> '0'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'release_tag' AS kind, concat('fix commit in release tag ', split(release_tags, ',')[0], ': ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND release_tags <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'commit' AS kind, concat('fix commit exists: ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND commit_exists = '1'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'pr_merged' AS kind, concat('PR merged ', merged_at, ': ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_pull' AND merged_at <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'branch' AS kind, concat('fix on release/', branch, ': ', tags) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix
        WHERE met = '1') ev ON ev.wait_id = c.wait_id
WHERE (c.tpl = 'upstream_fix' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'patch_available' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag', 'commit', 'pr_merged'))

sql:
SELECT 'debian_tracker' AS source, concat(t.release, ' ', t.status, CASE WHEN t.version <> '' THEN concat(' ', t.version) ELSE '' END) AS fact, t.note AS detail
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now t WHERE t.wait_id = 'CVE-2019-12067|qemu'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upstream_link' AS source, concat(u.kind, CASE WHEN u.release_tags <> '' THEN concat(' contained in release tag ', u.release_tags) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.merged_at <> '' THEN concat(' merged ', u.merged_at) ELSE '' END) AS fact, u.url AS detail
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream u WHERE u.wait_id = 'CVE-2019-12067|qemu'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upstream_releases' AS source, concat('latest stable release ', it.stable_versions[0]) AS fact, concat('recent: ', concat_ws(', ', slice(it.stable_versions, 1, 6))) AS detail
FROM rv3_up.rm_qemu LATERAL VIEW explode(items) i AS it WHERE lower(it.name) = 'qemu'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'osv' AS source, concat(o.id, ' modified ', substr(o.modified, 1, 10)) AS fact, substr(to_json(o.affected), 1, 700) AS detail
FROM rv3_up.osv_cve_2019_12067 o
UNION ALL
SELECT 'deferral_record' AS source, concat('deferred ', w.deferred_at) AS fact, concat('condition at deferral: ', w.condition_at_deferral, ' || condition now: ', w.condition_now) AS detail
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits w WHERE w.wait_id = 'CVE-2019-12067|qemu'

sql: DROP SCHEMASTORE VIEW reopen_due FROM rv3

CREATE SCHEMASTORE VIEW reopen_due WITH CONTAINER rv3 AS SELECT w.wait_id, w.cve, w.pkg, w.deferred_at, w.condition_at_deferral, w.condition_now, c.via, c.tpl, ev.kind, ev.detail
FROM (SELECT wait_id, 'original' AS via, tpl_deferral AS tpl, branch_deferral AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'latest' AS via, tpl_now AS tpl, branch_now AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits) c
JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = c.wait_id
JOIN (SELECT wait_id, 'unstable' AS kind, concat('unstable ships ', version) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now
        WHERE release = 'sid' AND status = 'fixed' AND version <> '0'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'release_tag' AS kind, concat('fix commit in release tag ', split(release_tags, ',')[0], ': ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND release_tags <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'commit' AS kind, concat('fix commit exists: ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND commit_exists = '1'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'pr_merged' AS kind, concat('PR merged ', merged_at, ': ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_pull' AND merged_at <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'branch' AS kind, concat('fix on release/', branch, ': ', tags) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix
        WHERE met = '1') ev ON ev.wait_id = c.wait_id
WHERE (c.tpl = 'upstream_fix' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'patch_available' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag', 'commit', 'pr_merged'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'branch_fix' AND ev.kind = 'branch' AND ev.detail LIKE concat('fix on release/', c.br, ':%'))

CREATE SCHEMASTORE VIEW reopen_due_v2 WITH CONTAINER rv3 AS -- Post-hoc fix (QA round 1): the sealed watch (reopen_due.sql) never checked whether bookworm had already resolved the wait.
SELECT w.wait_id, w.cve, w.pkg, w.deferred_at, w.condition_at_deferral, w.condition_now, c.via, c.tpl, ev.kind, ev.detail
FROM (SELECT wait_id, 'original' AS via, tpl_deferral AS tpl, branch_deferral AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'latest' AS via, tpl_now AS tpl, branch_now AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits) c
JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = c.wait_id
JOIN (SELECT wait_id, 'unstable' AS kind, concat('unstable ships ', version) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now
        WHERE release = 'sid' AND status = 'fixed' AND version <> '0'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'release_tag' AS kind, concat('fix commit in release tag ', split(release_tags, ',')[0], ': ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND release_tags <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'commit' AS kind, concat('fix commit exists: ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND commit_exists = '1'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'pr_merged' AS kind, concat('PR merged ', merged_at, ': ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_pull' AND merged_at <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'branch' AS kind, concat('fix on release/', branch, ': ', tags) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix
        WHERE met = '1') ev ON ev.wait_id = c.wait_id
WHERE w.wait_id NOT IN (SELECT r.wait_id FROM revisit_pg.rv3_resolved r)
  AND ((c.tpl = 'upstream_fix' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'patch_available' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag', 'commit', 'pr_merged'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'branch_fix' AND ev.kind = 'branch' AND ev.detail LIKE concat('fix on release/', c.br, ':%')))

sql: DROP SCHEMASTORE VIEW reopen_due FROM rv3

CREATE SCHEMASTORE VIEW reopen_due WITH CONTAINER rv3 AS SELECT w.wait_id, w.cve, w.pkg, w.deferred_at, w.condition_at_deferral, w.condition_now, c.via, c.tpl, ev.kind, ev.detail
FROM (SELECT wait_id, 'original' AS via, tpl_deferral AS tpl, branch_deferral AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'latest' AS via, tpl_now AS tpl, branch_now AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits) c
JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = c.wait_id
JOIN (SELECT wait_id, 'unstable' AS kind, concat('unstable ships ', version) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now
        WHERE release = 'sid' AND status = 'fixed' AND version <> '0'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'release_tag' AS kind, concat('fix commit in release tag ', split(release_tags, ',')[0], ': ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND release_tags <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'commit' AS kind, concat('fix commit exists: ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND commit_exists = '1'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'pr_merged' AS kind, concat('PR merged ', merged_at, ': ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_pull' AND merged_at <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'branch' AS kind, concat('fix on release/', branch, ': ', tags) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix
        WHERE met = '1') ev ON ev.wait_id = c.wait_id
WHERE (c.tpl = 'upstream_fix' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'patch_available' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag', 'commit', 'pr_merged'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'branch_fix' AND ev.kind = 'branch' AND ev.detail LIKE concat('fix on release/', c.br, ':%'))

CREATE SCHEMASTORE VIEW reopen_due_v2 WITH CONTAINER rv3 AS -- Post-hoc fix (QA round 1): the sealed watch (reopen_due.sql) never checked whether bookworm had already resolved the wait.
SELECT w.wait_id, w.cve, w.pkg, w.deferred_at, w.condition_at_deferral, w.condition_now, c.via, c.tpl, ev.kind, ev.detail
FROM (SELECT wait_id, 'original' AS via, tpl_deferral AS tpl, branch_deferral AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'latest' AS via, tpl_now AS tpl, branch_now AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits) c
JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = c.wait_id
JOIN (SELECT wait_id, 'unstable' AS kind, concat('unstable ships ', version) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now
        WHERE release = 'sid' AND status = 'fixed' AND version <> '0'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'release_tag' AS kind, concat('fix commit in release tag ', split(release_tags, ',')[0], ': ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND release_tags <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'commit' AS kind, concat('fix commit exists: ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND commit_exists = '1'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'pr_merged' AS kind, concat('PR merged ', merged_at, ': ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_pull' AND merged_at <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'branch' AS kind, concat('fix on release/', branch, ': ', tags) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix
        WHERE met = '1') ev ON ev.wait_id = c.wait_id

CREATE SCHEMASTORE VIEW reopen_due WITH CONTAINER rv3 AS SELECT w.wait_id, w.cve, w.pkg, w.deferred_at, w.condition_at_deferral, w.condition_now, c.via, c.tpl, ev.kind, ev.detail
FROM (SELECT wait_id, 'original' AS via, tpl_deferral AS tpl, branch_deferral AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'latest' AS via, tpl_now AS tpl, branch_now AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits) c
JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = c.wait_id
JOIN (SELECT wait_id, 'unstable' AS kind, concat('unstable ships ', version) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now
        WHERE release = 'sid' AND status = 'fixed' AND version <> '0'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'release_tag' AS kind, concat('fix commit in release tag ', split(release_tags, ',')[0], ': ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND release_tags <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'commit' AS kind, concat('fix commit exists: ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND commit_exists = '1'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'pr_merged' AS kind, concat('PR merged ', merged_at, ': ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_pull' AND merged_at <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'branch' AS kind, concat('fix on release/', branch, ': ', tags) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix
        WHERE met = '1') ev ON ev.wait_id = c.wait_id
WHERE (c.tpl = 'upstream_fix' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'patch_available' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag', 'commit', 'pr_merged'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'branch_fix' AND ev.kind = 'branch' AND ev.detail LIKE concat('fix on release/', c.br, ':%'))
DROP SCHEMASTORE VIEW reopen_due_v2 FROM rv3

CREATE SCHEMASTORE VIEW reopen_due_v2 WITH CONTAINER rv3 AS -- Post-hoc fixes: QA round 1, the sealed watch (reopen_due.sql) never checked whether bookworm had already resolved the wait;
-- QA round 4, a linked commit counts as the fix only when it qualifies (Fixed-by note, names the CVE, or dated after the deferral).
SELECT w.wait_id, w.cve, w.pkg, w.deferred_at, w.condition_at_deferral, w.condition_now, c.via, c.tpl, ev.kind, ev.detail
FROM (SELECT wait_id, 'original' AS via, tpl_deferral AS tpl, branch_deferral AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'latest' AS via, tpl_now AS tpl, branch_now AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits) c
JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = c.wait_id
JOIN (SELECT wait_id, 'unstable' AS kind, concat('unstable ships ', version) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now
        WHERE release = 'sid' AND status = 'fixed' AND version <> '0'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'release_tag' AS kind, concat('fix commit in release tag ', split(release_tags, ',')[0], ': ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND release_tags <> '' AND qualifies = '1'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'commit' AS kind, concat('fix commit exists: ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND commit_exists = '1' AND qualifies = '1'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'pr_merged' AS kind, concat('PR merged ', merged_at, ': ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_pull' AND merged_at <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'branch' AS kind, concat('fix on release/', branch, ': ', tags) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix
        WHERE met = '1') ev ON ev.wait_id = c.wait_id
WHERE w.wait_id NOT IN (SELECT r.wait_id FROM revisit_pg.rv3_resolved r)
  AND ((c.tpl = 'upstream_fix' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'patch_available' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag', 'commit', 'pr_merged'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'branch_fix' AND ev.kind = 'branch' AND ev.detail LIKE concat('fix on release/', c.br, ':%')))

sql: DROP SCHEMASTORE VIEW reopen_due FROM rv3

CREATE SCHEMASTORE VIEW reopen_due WITH CONTAINER rv3 AS SELECT w.wait_id, w.cve, w.pkg, w.deferred_at, w.condition_at_deferral, w.condition_now, c.via, c.tpl, ev.kind, ev.detail
FROM (SELECT wait_id, 'original' AS via, tpl_deferral AS tpl, branch_deferral AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'latest' AS via, tpl_now AS tpl, branch_now AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits) c
JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = c.wait_id
JOIN (SELECT wait_id, 'unstable' AS kind, concat('unstable ships ', version) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now
        WHERE release = 'sid' AND status = 'fixed' AND version <> '0'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'release_tag' AS kind, concat('fix commit in release tag ', split(release_tags, ',')[0], ': ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND release_tags <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'commit' AS kind, concat('fix commit exists: ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND commit_exists = '1'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'pr_merged' AS kind, concat('PR merged ', merged_at, ': ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_pull' AND merged_at <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'branch' AS kind, concat('fix on release/', branch, ': ', tags) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix
        WHERE met = '1') ev ON ev.wait_id = c.wait_id
WHERE (c.tpl = 'upstream_fix' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'patch_available' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag', 'commit', 'pr_merged'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'branch_fix' AND ev.kind = 'branch' AND ev.detail LIKE concat('fix on release/', c.br, ':%'))
DROP SCHEMASTORE VIEW reopen_due_v2 FROM rv3

CREATE SCHEMASTORE VIEW reopen_due_v2 WITH CONTAINER rv3 AS -- Post-hoc fixes: QA round 1, the sealed watch (reopen_due.sql) never checked whether bookworm had already resolved the wait;
-- QA round 4, a linked commit counts as the fix only when it qualifies (Fixed-by note, names the CVE, or dated after the deferral);
-- QA round 5, a signal reopens a deferral only if it appeared AFTER the deferral (it was not there when Debian decided to wait),
-- and an unstable fixed version only if it is on bookworm's version line and newer than bookworm (same epoch, Debian order).
SELECT w.wait_id, w.cve, w.pkg, w.deferred_at, w.condition_at_deferral, w.condition_now, c.via, c.tpl, ev.kind, ev.detail, ev.signal_date
FROM (SELECT wait_id, 'original' AS via, tpl_deferral AS tpl, branch_deferral AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'latest' AS via, tpl_now AS tpl, branch_now AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits) c
JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = c.wait_id
JOIN (SELECT wait_id, 'unstable' AS kind, concat('unstable ships ', version, ' (in the archive since ', since, ')') AS detail, since AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now
        WHERE release = 'sid' AND status = 'fixed' AND version <> '0' AND same_line = '1' AND fix_newer = '1' AND since <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'release_tag' AS kind, concat('fix commit first released ', tag_date, ': ', url) AS detail, tag_date AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND release_tags <> '' AND qualifies = '1' AND tag_date <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'commit' AS kind, concat('fix commit dated ', commit_date, ': ', url) AS detail, commit_date AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND commit_exists = '1' AND qualifies = '1' AND commit_date <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'pr_merged' AS kind, concat('PR merged ', merged_at, ': ', url) AS detail, merged_at AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_pull' AND merged_at <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'branch' AS kind, concat('fix on release/', branch, ': ', tags, ' (first tag ', tag_date, ')') AS detail, tag_date AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix
        WHERE met = '1' AND tag_date <> '') ev ON ev.wait_id = c.wait_id
WHERE w.wait_id NOT IN (SELECT r.wait_id FROM revisit_pg.rv3_resolved r)
  AND ev.signal_date > w.deferred_at
  AND ((c.tpl = 'upstream_fix' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'patch_available' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag', 'commit', 'pr_merged'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'branch_fix' AND ev.kind = 'branch' AND ev.detail LIKE concat('fix on release/', c.br, ':%')))

-- Post-hoc fixes: QA round 1, the sealed watch (reopen_due.sql) never checked whether bookworm had already resolved the wait;
-- QA round 4, a linked commit counts as the fix only when it qualifies (Fixed-by note, names the CVE, or dated after the deferral);
-- QA round 5, a signal reopens a deferral only if it appeared AFTER the deferral (it was not there when Debian decided to wait),
-- and an unstable fixed version only if it is on bookworm's version line and newer than bookworm (same epoch, Debian order).
SELECT w.wait_id, w.cve, w.pkg, w.deferred_at, w.condition_at_deferral, w.condition_now, c.via, c.tpl, ev.kind, ev.detail, ev.signal_date
FROM (SELECT wait_id, 'original' AS via, tpl_deferral AS tpl, branch_deferral AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'latest' AS via, tpl_now AS tpl, branch_now AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits) c
JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = c.wait_id
JOIN (SELECT wait_id, 'unstable' AS kind, concat('unstable ships ', version, ' (in the archive since ', since, ')') AS detail, since AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now
        WHERE release = 'sid' AND status = 'fixed' AND version <> '0' 
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'release_tag' AS kind, concat('fix commit first released ', tag_date, ': ', url) AS detail, tag_date AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND release_tags <> '' AND qualifies = '1'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'commit' AS kind, concat('fix commit dated ', commit_date, ': ', url) AS detail, commit_date AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND commit_exists = '1' AND qualifies = '1' AND commit_date <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'pr_merged' AS kind, concat('PR merged ', merged_at, ': ', url) AS detail, merged_at AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_pull' AND merged_at <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'branch' AS kind, concat('fix on release/', branch, ': ', tags, ' (first tag ', tag_date, ')') AS detail, tag_date AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix
        WHERE met = '1') ev ON ev.wait_id = c.wait_id
WHERE w.wait_id NOT IN (SELECT r.wait_id FROM revisit_pg.rv3_resolved r)

  AND ((c.tpl = 'upstream_fix' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'patch_available' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag', 'commit', 'pr_merged'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'branch_fix' AND ev.kind = 'branch' AND ev.detail LIKE concat('fix on release/', c.br, ':%')))

SELECT 'debian_tracker' AS source, concat(t.release, ' ', t.status, CASE WHEN t.version <> '' THEN concat(' ', t.version) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN t.release = 'sid' AND t.status = 'fixed' THEN concat(CASE WHEN t.since = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN t.since > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', t.since, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', t.since, ']') END,
            CASE WHEN t.same_line = '0' THEN concat(' [not on the bookworm version line: ', t.line_note, ']')
                 WHEN t.fix_newer = '0' THEN concat(' [not newer than bookworm ', t.bw_versions, ']')
                 ELSE concat(' [same version line, newer than bookworm ', t.bw_versions, ']') END) ELSE '' END) AS fact,
       t.note AS detail, t.since AS signal_date, CASE WHEN t.bw_versions <> '' THEN concat('fixed ', t.version, ' vs bookworm ', t.bw_versions) ELSE '' END AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now t JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = t.wait_id WHERE t.wait_id = 'CVE-2025-22921|ffmpeg'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upstream_link' AS source, concat(u.kind, CASE WHEN u.release_tags <> '' THEN concat(' contained in release tag ', u.release_tags) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.merged_at <> '' THEN concat(' merged ', u.merged_at) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.commit_date <> '' AND u.kind = 'gh_commit' THEN concat(' committed ', u.commit_date) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN concat(' first released ', u.tag_date) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.qualifies = '1' THEN concat(' [counts as the fix: ', u.why, ']') ELSE concat(' [NOT the fix by the rule: ', u.why, ']') END,
       CASE WHEN CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END, ']') END) AS fact, u.url AS detail, CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream u JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = u.wait_id WHERE u.wait_id = 'CVE-2025-22921|ffmpeg'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upstream_branch' AS source, concat('fix on upstream release/', b.branch, CASE WHEN b.met = '1' THEN ' branch: yes' ELSE ' branch: no' END,
       CASE WHEN b.met = '1' THEN CASE WHEN b.tag_date = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN b.tag_date > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', b.tag_date, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', b.tag_date, ']') END ELSE '' END) AS fact,
       concat('release tags: ', b.tags) AS detail, b.tag_date AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix b JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = b.wait_id WHERE b.wait_id = 'CVE-2025-22921|ffmpeg'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upstream_releases' AS source, concat('latest stable release ', it.stable_versions[0], ' [no release date: context only]') AS fact,
       concat('recent: ', concat_ws(', ', slice(it.stable_versions, 1, 6))) AS detail, '' AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM rv3_up.rm_ffmpeg LATERAL VIEW explode(items) i AS it WHERE lower(it.name) = 'ffmpeg'

sql: DROP SCHEMASTORE VIEW reopen_due FROM rv3

CREATE SCHEMASTORE VIEW reopen_due WITH CONTAINER rv3 AS SELECT w.wait_id, w.cve, w.pkg, w.deferred_at, w.condition_at_deferral, w.condition_now, c.via, c.tpl, ev.kind, ev.detail
FROM (SELECT wait_id, 'original' AS via, tpl_deferral AS tpl, branch_deferral AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'latest' AS via, tpl_now AS tpl, branch_now AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits) c
JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = c.wait_id
JOIN (SELECT wait_id, 'unstable' AS kind, concat('unstable ships ', version) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now
        WHERE release = 'sid' AND status = 'fixed' AND version <> '0'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'release_tag' AS kind, concat('fix commit in release tag ', split(release_tags, ',')[0], ': ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND release_tags <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'commit' AS kind, concat('fix commit exists: ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND commit_exists = '1'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'pr_merged' AS kind, concat('PR merged ', merged_at, ': ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_pull' AND merged_at <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'branch' AS kind, concat('fix on release/', branch, ': ', tags) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix
        WHERE met = '1') ev ON ev.wait_id = c.wait_id
WHERE (c.tpl = 'upstream_fix' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'patch_available' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag', 'commit', 'pr_merged'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'branch_fix' AND ev.kind = 'branch' AND ev.detail LIKE concat('fix on release/', c.br, ':%'))
DROP SCHEMASTORE VIEW reopen_due_v2 FROM rv3

CREATE SCHEMASTORE VIEW reopen_due_v2 WITH CONTAINER rv3 AS -- Post-hoc fixes: QA round 1, the sealed watch (reopen_due.sql) never checked whether bookworm had already resolved the wait;
-- QA round 4, a linked commit counts as the fix only when it qualifies (Fixed-by note, names the CVE, or dated after the deferral);
-- QA round 5, a signal reopens a deferral only if it appeared AFTER the deferral (it was not there when Debian decided to wait),
-- and an unstable fixed version only if it is on bookworm's version line and newer than bookworm (same epoch, Debian order).
SELECT w.wait_id, w.cve, w.pkg, w.deferred_at, w.condition_at_deferral, w.condition_now, c.via, c.tpl, ev.kind, ev.detail, ev.signal_date
FROM (SELECT wait_id, 'original' AS via, tpl_deferral AS tpl, branch_deferral AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'latest' AS via, tpl_now AS tpl, branch_now AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits) c
JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = c.wait_id
JOIN (SELECT wait_id, 'unstable' AS kind, concat('unstable ships ', version, ' (in the archive since ', since, ')') AS detail, since AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now
        WHERE release = 'sid' AND status = 'fixed' AND version <> '0' AND same_line = '1' AND fix_newer = '1' AND since <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'release_tag' AS kind, concat('fix commit first released ', tag_date, ': ', url) AS detail, tag_date AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND release_tags <> '' AND qualifies = '1' AND tag_date <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'commit' AS kind, concat('fix commit dated ', commit_date, ': ', url) AS detail, commit_date AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND commit_exists = '1' AND qualifies = '1' AND commit_date <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'pr_merged' AS kind, concat('PR merged ', merged_at, ': ', url) AS detail, merged_at AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_pull' AND merged_at <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'branch' AS kind, concat('fix on release/', branch, ': ', tags, ' (first tag ', tag_date, ')') AS detail, tag_date AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix
        WHERE met = '1' AND tag_date <> '') ev ON ev.wait_id = c.wait_id
WHERE w.wait_id NOT IN (SELECT r.wait_id FROM revisit_pg.rv3_resolved r)
  AND ev.signal_date > w.deferred_at
  AND ((c.tpl = 'upstream_fix' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'patch_available' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag', 'commit', 'pr_merged'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'branch_fix' AND ev.kind = 'branch' AND ev.detail LIKE concat('fix on release/', c.br, ':%')))

-- Post-hoc fixes: QA round 1, the sealed watch (reopen_due.sql) never checked whether bookworm had already resolved the wait;
-- QA round 4, a linked commit counts as the fix only when it qualifies (Fixed-by note, names the CVE, or dated after the deferral);
-- QA round 5, a signal reopens a deferral only if it appeared AFTER the deferral (it was not there when Debian decided to wait),
-- and an unstable fixed version only if it is on bookworm's version line and newer than bookworm (same epoch, Debian order).
SELECT w.wait_id, w.cve, w.pkg, w.deferred_at, w.condition_at_deferral, w.condition_now, c.via, c.tpl, ev.kind, ev.detail, ev.signal_date
FROM (SELECT wait_id, 'original' AS via, tpl_deferral AS tpl, branch_deferral AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'latest' AS via, tpl_now AS tpl, branch_now AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits) c
JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = c.wait_id
JOIN (SELECT wait_id, 'unstable' AS kind, concat('unstable ships ', version, ' (in the archive since ', since, ')') AS detail, since AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now
        WHERE release = 'sid' AND status = 'fixed' AND version <> '0' 
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'release_tag' AS kind, concat('fix commit first released ', tag_date, ': ', url) AS detail, tag_date AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND release_tags <> '' AND qualifies = '1'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'commit' AS kind, concat('fix commit dated ', commit_date, ': ', url) AS detail, commit_date AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND commit_exists = '1' AND qualifies = '1' AND commit_date <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'pr_merged' AS kind, concat('PR merged ', merged_at, ': ', url) AS detail, merged_at AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_pull' AND merged_at <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'branch' AS kind, concat('fix on release/', branch, ': ', tags, ' (first tag ', tag_date, ')') AS detail, tag_date AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix
        WHERE met = '1') ev ON ev.wait_id = c.wait_id
WHERE w.wait_id NOT IN (SELECT r.wait_id FROM revisit_pg.rv3_resolved r)

  AND ((c.tpl = 'upstream_fix' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'patch_available' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag', 'commit', 'pr_merged'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'branch_fix' AND ev.kind = 'branch' AND ev.detail LIKE concat('fix on release/', c.br, ':%')))

SELECT 'debian_tracker' AS source, concat(t.release, ' ', t.status, CASE WHEN t.version <> '' THEN concat(' ', t.version) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN t.release = 'sid' AND t.status = 'fixed' THEN concat(CASE WHEN t.since = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN t.since > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', t.since, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', t.since, ']') END,
            CASE WHEN t.same_line = '0' THEN concat(' [not on the bookworm version line: ', t.line_note, ']')
                 WHEN t.fix_newer = '0' THEN concat(' [not newer than bookworm ', t.bw_versions, ']')
                 ELSE concat(' [same version line, newer than bookworm ', t.bw_versions, ']') END) ELSE '' END) AS fact,
       t.note AS detail, t.since AS signal_date, CASE WHEN t.bw_versions <> '' THEN concat('fixed ', t.version, ' vs bookworm ', t.bw_versions) ELSE '' END AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now t JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = t.wait_id WHERE t.wait_id = 'CVE-2025-14932|netcdf'

       CASE WHEN u.commit_date <> '' AND u.kind = 'gh_commit' THEN concat(' committed ', u.commit_date) ELSE '' END,

sql: DROP SCHEMASTORE VIEW reopen_due FROM rv3

CREATE SCHEMASTORE VIEW reopen_due WITH CONTAINER rv3 AS SELECT w.wait_id, w.cve, w.pkg, w.deferred_at, w.condition_at_deferral, w.condition_now, c.via, c.tpl, ev.kind, ev.detail
FROM (SELECT wait_id, 'original' AS via, tpl_deferral AS tpl, branch_deferral AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'latest' AS via, tpl_now AS tpl, branch_now AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits) c
JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = c.wait_id
JOIN (SELECT wait_id, 'unstable' AS kind, concat('unstable ships ', version) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now
        WHERE release = 'sid' AND status = 'fixed' AND version <> '0'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'release_tag' AS kind, concat('fix commit in release tag ', split(release_tags, ',')[0], ': ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND release_tags <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'commit' AS kind, concat('fix commit exists: ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND commit_exists = '1'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'pr_merged' AS kind, concat('PR merged ', merged_at, ': ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_pull' AND merged_at <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'branch' AS kind, concat('fix on release/', branch, ': ', tags) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix
        WHERE met = '1') ev ON ev.wait_id = c.wait_id
WHERE (c.tpl = 'upstream_fix' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'patch_available' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag', 'commit', 'pr_merged'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'branch_fix' AND ev.kind = 'branch' AND ev.detail LIKE concat('fix on release/', c.br, ':%'))
DROP SCHEMASTORE VIEW reopen_due_v2 FROM rv3

CREATE SCHEMASTORE VIEW reopen_due_v2 WITH CONTAINER rv3 AS -- Post-hoc fixes: QA round 1, the sealed watch (reopen_due.sql) never checked whether bookworm had already resolved the wait;
-- QA round 4, a linked commit counts as the fix only when it qualifies (Fixed-by note, names the CVE, or dated after the deferral);
-- QA round 5, a signal reopens a deferral only if it appeared AFTER the deferral (it was not there when Debian decided to wait),
-- and an unstable fixed version only if it is on bookworm's version line and newer than bookworm (same epoch, Debian order).
SELECT w.wait_id, w.cve, w.pkg, w.deferred_at, w.condition_at_deferral, w.condition_now, c.via, c.tpl, ev.kind, ev.detail, ev.signal_date
FROM (SELECT wait_id, 'original' AS via, tpl_deferral AS tpl, branch_deferral AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'latest' AS via, tpl_now AS tpl, branch_now AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits) c
JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = c.wait_id
JOIN (SELECT wait_id, 'unstable' AS kind, concat('unstable ships ', version, ' (in the archive since ', since, ')') AS detail, since AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now
        WHERE release = 'sid' AND status = 'fixed' AND version <> '0' AND same_line = '1' AND fix_newer = '1' AND since <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'release_tag' AS kind, concat('fix commit first released ', tag_date, ': ', url) AS detail, tag_date AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND release_tags <> '' AND qualifies = '1' AND tag_date <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'commit' AS kind, concat('fix commit dated ', commit_date, ': ', url) AS detail, commit_date AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND commit_exists = '1' AND qualifies = '1' AND commit_date <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'pr_merged' AS kind, concat('PR merged ', merged_at, ': ', url) AS detail, merged_at AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_pull' AND merged_at <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'branch' AS kind, concat('fix on release/', branch, ': ', tags, ' (first tag ', tag_date, ')') AS detail, tag_date AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix
        WHERE met = '1' AND tag_date <> '') ev ON ev.wait_id = c.wait_id
WHERE w.wait_id NOT IN (SELECT r.wait_id FROM revisit_pg.rv3_resolved r)
  AND ev.signal_date > w.deferred_at
  AND ((c.tpl = 'upstream_fix' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'patch_available' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag', 'commit', 'pr_merged'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'branch_fix' AND ev.kind = 'branch' AND ev.detail LIKE concat('fix on release/', c.br, ':%')))

-- Post-hoc fixes: QA round 1, the sealed watch (reopen_due.sql) never checked whether bookworm had already resolved the wait;
-- QA round 4, a linked commit counts as the fix only when it qualifies (Fixed-by note, names the CVE, or dated after the deferral);
-- QA round 5, a signal reopens a deferral only if it appeared AFTER the deferral (it was not there when Debian decided to wait),
-- and an unstable fixed version only if it is on bookworm's version line and newer than bookworm (same epoch, Debian order).
SELECT w.wait_id, w.cve, w.pkg, w.deferred_at, w.condition_at_deferral, w.condition_now, c.via, c.tpl, ev.kind, ev.detail, ev.signal_date
FROM (SELECT wait_id, 'original' AS via, tpl_deferral AS tpl, branch_deferral AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'latest' AS via, tpl_now AS tpl, branch_now AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits) c
JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = c.wait_id
JOIN (SELECT wait_id, 'unstable' AS kind, concat('unstable ships ', version, ' (in the archive since ', since, ')') AS detail, since AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now
        WHERE release = 'sid' AND status = 'fixed' AND version <> '0' 
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'release_tag' AS kind, concat('fix commit first released ', tag_date, ': ', url) AS detail, tag_date AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND release_tags <> '' AND qualifies = '1'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'commit' AS kind, concat('fix commit dated ', commit_date, ': ', url) AS detail, commit_date AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND commit_exists = '1' AND qualifies = '1' AND commit_date <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'pr_merged' AS kind, concat('PR merged ', merged_at, ': ', url) AS detail, merged_at AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_pull' AND merged_at <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'branch' AS kind, concat('fix on release/', branch, ': ', tags, ' (first tag ', tag_date, ')') AS detail, tag_date AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix
        WHERE met = '1') ev ON ev.wait_id = c.wait_id
WHERE w.wait_id NOT IN (SELECT r.wait_id FROM revisit_pg.rv3_resolved r)

  AND ((c.tpl = 'upstream_fix' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'patch_available' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag', 'commit', 'pr_merged'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'branch_fix' AND ev.kind = 'branch' AND ev.detail LIKE concat('fix on release/', c.br, ':%')))

SELECT 'debian_tracker' AS source, concat(t.release, ' ', t.status, CASE WHEN t.version <> '' THEN concat(' ', t.version) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN t.release = 'sid' AND t.status = 'fixed' THEN concat(CASE WHEN t.since = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN t.since > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', t.since, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', t.since, ']') END,
            CASE WHEN t.same_line = '0' THEN concat(' [not on the bookworm version line: ', t.line_note, ']')
                 WHEN t.fix_newer = '0' THEN concat(' [not newer than bookworm ', t.bw_versions, ']')
                 ELSE concat(' [same version line, newer than bookworm ', t.bw_versions, ']') END) ELSE '' END) AS fact,
       t.note AS detail, t.since AS signal_date, CASE WHEN t.bw_versions <> '' THEN concat('fixed ', t.version, ' vs bookworm ', t.bw_versions) ELSE '' END AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now t JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = t.wait_id WHERE t.wait_id = 'CVE-2025-14932|netcdf'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upstream_link' AS source, concat(u.kind, CASE WHEN u.release_tags <> '' THEN concat(' contained in ', size(split(u.release_tags, ',')), ' release tags (latest listed ', split(u.release_tags, ',')[0], ')') ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.merged_at <> '' THEN concat(' merged ', u.merged_at) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.commit_date <> '' AND u.kind = 'gh_commit' THEN concat(' committed ', u.commit_date) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.tag_date = '' THEN '' WHEN u.tag_bound = 'at_most' THEN concat(' released on or before ', u.tag_date) ELSE concat(' first released ', u.tag_date) END,
       CASE WHEN u.qualifies = '1' THEN concat(' [counts as the fix: ', u.why, ']') ELSE concat(' [NOT the fix by the rule: ', u.why, ']') END,
       CASE WHEN CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END, ']') END) AS fact, u.url AS detail, CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream u JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = u.wait_id WHERE u.wait_id = 'CVE-2025-14932|netcdf'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upstream_branch' AS source, concat('fix on upstream release/', b.branch, CASE WHEN b.met = '1' THEN ' branch: yes' ELSE ' branch: no' END,
       CASE WHEN b.met = '1' THEN CASE WHEN b.tag_date = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN b.tag_date > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', b.tag_date, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', b.tag_date, ']') END ELSE '' END) AS fact,
       concat('release tags: ', b.tags) AS detail, b.tag_date AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix b JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = b.wait_id WHERE b.wait_id = 'CVE-2025-14932|netcdf'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upstream_releases' AS source, concat('latest stable release ', it.stable_versions[0], ' [no release date: context only]') AS fact,
       concat('recent: ', concat_ws(', ', slice(it.stable_versions, 1, 6))) AS detail, '' AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM rv3_up.rm_netcdf LATERAL VIEW explode(items) i AS it WHERE lower(it.name) = 'netcdf'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'osv' AS source, concat(o.id, ' modified ', substr(o.modified, 1, 10), ' [no date for when the fix appeared: context only]') AS fact,
       substr(to_json(o.affected), 1, 700) AS detail, '' AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM rv3_up.osv_cve_2025_14932 o
UNION ALL
SELECT 'deferral_record' AS source, concat('deferred ', w.deferred_at) AS fact, concat('condition at deferral: ', w.condition_at_deferral, ' || condition now: ', w.condition_now) AS detail,
       w.deferred_at AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits w WHERE w.wait_id = 'CVE-2025-14932|netcdf'

       CASE WHEN u.commit_date <> '' AND u.kind = 'gh_commit' THEN concat(' committed ', u.commit_date) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.tag_date = '' THEN '' WHEN u.tag_bound = 'at_most' THEN concat(' released on or before ', u.tag_date) ELSE concat(' first released ', u.tag_date) END,
       CASE WHEN u.qualifies = '1' THEN concat(' [counts as the fix: ', u.why, ']') ELSE concat(' [NOT the fix by the rule: ', u.why, ']') END,
       CASE WHEN CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END, ']') END) AS fact, u.url AS detail, CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream u JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = u.wait_id WHERE u.wait_id = 'CVE-2022-29977|libsixel'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upstream_branch' AS source, concat('fix on upstream release/', b.branch, CASE WHEN b.met = '1' THEN ' branch: yes' ELSE ' branch: no' END,
       CASE WHEN b.met = '1' THEN CASE WHEN b.tag_date = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN b.tag_date > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', b.tag_date, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', b.tag_date, ']') END ELSE '' END) AS fact,
       concat('release tags: ', b.tags) AS detail, b.tag_date AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix b JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = b.wait_id WHERE b.wait_id = 'CVE-2022-29977|libsixel'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upstream_releases' AS source, concat('latest stable release ', it.stable_versions[0], ' [no release date: context only]') AS fact,
       concat('recent: ', concat_ws(', ', slice(it.stable_versions, 1, 6))) AS detail, '' AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM rv3_up.rm_libsixel LATERAL VIEW explode(items) i AS it WHERE lower(it.name) = 'libsixel'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'osv' AS source, concat(o.id, ' modified ', substr(o.modified, 1, 10), ' [no date for when the fix appeared: context only]') AS fact,
       substr(to_json(o.affected), 1, 700) AS detail, '' AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM rv3_up.osv_cve_2022_29977 o
UNION ALL
SELECT 'deferral_record' AS source, concat('deferred ', w.deferred_at) AS fact, concat('condition at deferral: ', w.condition_at_deferral, ' || condition now: ', w.condition_now) AS detail,
       w.deferred_at AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits w WHERE w.wait_id = 'CVE-2022-29977|libsixel'

CREATE SCHEMASTORE VIEW reopen_due WITH CONTAINER rv3 AS SELECT w.wait_id, w.cve, w.pkg, w.deferred_at, w.condition_at_deferral, w.condition_now, c.via, c.tpl, ev.kind, ev.detail
FROM (SELECT wait_id, 'original' AS via, tpl_deferral AS tpl, branch_deferral AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'latest' AS via, tpl_now AS tpl, branch_now AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits) c
JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = c.wait_id
JOIN (SELECT wait_id, 'unstable' AS kind, concat('unstable ships ', version) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now
        WHERE release = 'sid' AND status = 'fixed' AND version <> '0'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'release_tag' AS kind, concat('fix commit in release tag ', split(release_tags, ',')[0], ': ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND release_tags <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'commit' AS kind, concat('fix commit exists: ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND commit_exists = '1'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'pr_merged' AS kind, concat('PR merged ', merged_at, ': ', url) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_pull' AND merged_at <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'branch' AS kind, concat('fix on release/', branch, ': ', tags) AS detail FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix
        WHERE met = '1') ev ON ev.wait_id = c.wait_id
WHERE (c.tpl = 'upstream_fix' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'patch_available' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag', 'commit', 'pr_merged'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'branch_fix' AND ev.kind = 'branch' AND ev.detail LIKE concat('fix on release/', c.br, ':%'))

CREATE SCHEMASTORE VIEW reopen_due_v2 WITH CONTAINER rv3 AS -- Post-hoc fixes: QA round 1, the sealed watch (reopen_due.sql) never checked whether bookworm had already resolved the wait;
-- QA round 4, a linked commit counts as the fix only when it qualifies (Fixed-by note, names the CVE, or dated after the deferral);
-- QA round 5, a signal reopens a deferral only if it appeared AFTER the deferral (it was not there when Debian decided to wait),
-- and an unstable fixed version only if it is on bookworm's version line and newer than bookworm (same epoch, Debian order).
SELECT w.wait_id, w.cve, w.pkg, w.deferred_at, w.condition_at_deferral, w.condition_now, c.via, c.tpl, ev.kind, ev.detail, ev.signal_date
FROM (SELECT wait_id, 'original' AS via, tpl_deferral AS tpl, branch_deferral AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'latest' AS via, tpl_now AS tpl, branch_now AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits) c
JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = c.wait_id
JOIN (SELECT wait_id, 'unstable' AS kind, concat('unstable ships ', version, ' (in the archive since ', since, ')') AS detail, since AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now
        WHERE release = 'sid' AND status = 'fixed' AND version <> '0' AND same_line = '1' AND fix_newer = '1' AND since <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'release_tag' AS kind, concat('fix commit first released ', tag_date, ': ', url) AS detail, tag_date AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND release_tags <> '' AND qualifies = '1' AND tag_date <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'commit' AS kind, concat('fix commit authored ', commit_date, ': ', url) AS detail, commit_date AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND commit_exists = '1' AND qualifies = '1' AND commit_date <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'pr_merged' AS kind, concat('PR merged ', merged_at, ': ', url) AS detail, merged_at AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_pull' AND merged_at <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'branch' AS kind, concat('fix on release/', branch, ': ', tags, ' (first tag ', tag_date, ')') AS detail, tag_date AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix
        WHERE met = '1' AND tag_date <> '') ev ON ev.wait_id = c.wait_id
WHERE w.wait_id NOT IN (SELECT r.wait_id FROM revisit_pg.rv3_resolved r)
  AND ev.signal_date > w.deferred_at
  AND ((c.tpl = 'upstream_fix' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'patch_available' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag', 'commit', 'pr_merged'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'branch_fix' AND ev.kind = 'branch' AND ev.detail LIKE concat('fix on release/', c.br, ':%')))

-- Post-hoc fixes: QA round 1, the sealed watch (reopen_due.sql) never checked whether bookworm had already resolved the wait;
-- QA round 4, a linked commit counts as the fix only when it qualifies (Fixed-by note, names the CVE, or dated after the deferral);
-- QA round 5, a signal reopens a deferral only if it appeared AFTER the deferral (it was not there when Debian decided to wait),
-- and an unstable fixed version only if it is on bookworm's version line and newer than bookworm (same epoch, Debian order).
SELECT w.wait_id, w.cve, w.pkg, w.deferred_at, w.condition_at_deferral, w.condition_now, c.via, c.tpl, ev.kind, ev.detail, ev.signal_date
FROM (SELECT wait_id, 'original' AS via, tpl_deferral AS tpl, branch_deferral AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'latest' AS via, tpl_now AS tpl, branch_now AS br FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits) c
JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = c.wait_id
JOIN (SELECT wait_id, 'unstable' AS kind, concat('unstable ships ', version, ' (in the archive since ', since, ')') AS detail, since AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now
        WHERE release = 'sid' AND status = 'fixed' AND version <> '0' 
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'release_tag' AS kind, concat('fix commit first released ', tag_date, ': ', url) AS detail, tag_date AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND release_tags <> '' AND qualifies = '1'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'commit' AS kind, concat('fix commit authored ', commit_date, ': ', url) AS detail, commit_date AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_commit' AND commit_exists = '1' AND qualifies = '1' AND commit_date <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'pr_merged' AS kind, concat('PR merged ', merged_at, ': ', url) AS detail, merged_at AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream
        WHERE kind = 'gh_pull' AND merged_at <> ''
      UNION ALL
      SELECT wait_id, 'branch' AS kind, concat('fix on release/', branch, ': ', tags, ' (first tag ', tag_date, ')') AS detail, tag_date AS signal_date
        FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix
        WHERE met = '1') ev ON ev.wait_id = c.wait_id
WHERE w.wait_id NOT IN (SELECT r.wait_id FROM revisit_pg.rv3_resolved r)

  AND ((c.tpl = 'upstream_fix' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'patch_available' AND ev.kind IN ('unstable', 'release_tag', 'commit', 'pr_merged'))
   OR (c.tpl = 'branch_fix' AND ev.kind = 'branch' AND ev.detail LIKE concat('fix on release/', c.br, ':%')))

sql:
SELECT 'debian_tracker' AS source, concat(t.release, ' ', t.status, CASE WHEN t.version <> '' THEN concat(' ', t.version) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN t.release = 'sid' AND t.status = 'fixed' THEN concat(CASE WHEN t.since = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN t.since > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', t.since, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', t.since, ']') END,
            CASE WHEN t.same_line = '0' THEN concat(' [not on the bookworm version line: ', t.line_note, ']')
                 WHEN t.fix_newer = '0' THEN concat(' [not newer than bookworm ', t.bw_versions, ']')
                 ELSE concat(' [same version line, newer than bookworm ', t.bw_versions, ']') END) ELSE '' END) AS fact,
       t.note AS detail, t.since AS signal_date, CASE WHEN t.bw_versions <> '' THEN concat('fixed ', t.version, ' vs bookworm ', t.bw_versions) ELSE '' END AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now t JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = t.wait_id WHERE t.wait_id = 'CVE-2025-14932|netcdf'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upstream_link' AS source, concat(u.kind, CASE WHEN u.release_tags <> '' THEN concat(' contained in ', size(split(u.release_tags, ',')), ' release tags (latest listed ', split(u.release_tags, ',')[0], ')') ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.merged_at <> '' THEN concat(' merged ', u.merged_at) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.commit_date <> '' AND u.kind = 'gh_commit' THEN concat(' authored ', u.commit_date) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.tag_date = '' THEN '' WHEN u.tag_bound = 'at_most' THEN concat(' already released by ', u.tag_date, ' (the oldest of the newest tags listed)') ELSE concat(' first released ', u.tag_date) END,
       CASE WHEN u.qualifies = '1' THEN concat(' [counts as the fix: ', u.why, ']') ELSE concat(' [NOT the fix by the rule: ', u.why, ']') END,
       CASE WHEN CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END, ']') END) AS fact, u.url AS detail, CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream u JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = u.wait_id WHERE u.wait_id = 'CVE-2025-14932|netcdf'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upstream_branch' AS source, concat('fix on upstream release/', b.branch, CASE WHEN b.met = '1' THEN ' branch: yes' ELSE ' branch: no' END,
       CASE WHEN b.met = '1' THEN CASE WHEN b.tag_date = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN b.tag_date > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', b.tag_date, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', b.tag_date, ']') END ELSE '' END) AS fact,
       concat('release tags: ', b.tags) AS detail, b.tag_date AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix b JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = b.wait_id WHERE b.wait_id = 'CVE-2025-14932|netcdf'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upstream_releases' AS source, concat('latest stable release ', it.stable_versions[0], ' [no release date: context only]') AS fact,
       concat('recent: ', concat_ws(', ', slice(it.stable_versions, 1, 6))) AS detail, '' AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM rv3_up.rm_netcdf LATERAL VIEW explode(items) i AS it WHERE lower(it.name) = 'netcdf'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'osv' AS source, concat(o.id, ' modified ', substr(o.modified, 1, 10), ' [no date for when the fix appeared: context only]') AS fact,
       substr(to_json(o.affected), 1, 700) AS detail, '' AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM rv3_up.osv_cve_2025_14932 o
UNION ALL
SELECT 'deferral_record' AS source, concat('deferred ', w.deferred_at) AS fact, concat('condition at deferral: ', w.condition_at_deferral, ' || condition now: ', w.condition_now) AS detail,
       w.deferred_at AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits w WHERE w.wait_id = 'CVE-2025-14932|netcdf'

SELECT 'debian_tracker' AS source, concat(t.release, ' ', t.status, CASE WHEN t.version <> '' THEN concat(' ', t.version) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN t.release = 'sid' AND t.status = 'fixed' THEN concat(CASE WHEN t.since = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN t.since > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', t.since, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', t.since, ']') END,
            CASE WHEN t.same_line = '0' THEN concat(' [not on the bookworm version line: ', t.line_note, ']')
                 WHEN t.fix_newer = '0' THEN concat(' [not newer than bookworm ', t.bw_versions, ']')
                 ELSE concat(' [same version line, newer than bookworm ', t.bw_versions, ']') END) ELSE '' END) AS fact,
       t.note AS detail, t.since AS signal_date, CASE WHEN t.bw_versions <> '' THEN concat('fixed ', t.version, ' vs bookworm ', t.bw_versions) ELSE '' END AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now t JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = t.wait_id WHERE t.wait_id = 'CVE-2022-29977|libsixel'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upstream_link' AS source, concat(u.kind, CASE WHEN u.release_tags <> '' THEN concat(' contained in ', size(split(u.release_tags, ',')), ' release tags (latest listed ', split(u.release_tags, ',')[0], ')') ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.merged_at <> '' THEN concat(' merged ', u.merged_at) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.commit_date <> '' AND u.kind = 'gh_commit' THEN concat(' authored ', u.commit_date) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN u.tag_date = '' THEN '' WHEN u.tag_bound = 'at_most' THEN concat(' already released by ', u.tag_date, ' (the oldest of the newest tags listed)') ELSE concat(' first released ', u.tag_date) END,
       CASE WHEN u.qualifies = '1' THEN concat(' [counts as the fix: ', u.why, ']') ELSE concat(' [NOT the fix by the rule: ', u.why, ']') END,
       CASE WHEN CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END, ']') END) AS fact, u.url AS detail, CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream u JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = u.wait_id WHERE u.wait_id = 'CVE-2022-29977|libsixel'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upstream_branch' AS source, concat('fix on upstream release/', b.branch, CASE WHEN b.met = '1' THEN ' branch: yes' ELSE ' branch: no' END,
       CASE WHEN b.met = '1' THEN CASE WHEN b.tag_date = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN b.tag_date > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', b.tag_date, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', b.tag_date, ']') END ELSE '' END) AS fact,
       concat('release tags: ', b.tags) AS detail, b.tag_date AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix b JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = b.wait_id WHERE b.wait_id = 'CVE-2022-29977|libsixel'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upstream_releases' AS source, concat('latest stable release ', it.stable_versions[0], ' [no release date: context only]') AS fact,
       concat('recent: ', concat_ws(', ', slice(it.stable_versions, 1, 6))) AS detail, '' AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM rv3_up.rm_libsixel LATERAL VIEW explode(items) i AS it WHERE lower(it.name) = 'libsixel'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'osv' AS source, concat(o.id, ' modified ', substr(o.modified, 1, 10), ' [no date for when the fix appeared: context only]') AS fact,
       substr(to_json(o.affected), 1, 700) AS detail, '' AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM rv3_up.osv_cve_2022_29977 o
UNION ALL
SELECT 'deferral_record' AS source, concat('deferred ', w.deferred_at) AS fact, concat('condition at deferral: ', w.condition_at_deferral, ' || condition now: ', w.condition_now) AS detail,
       w.deferred_at AS signal_date, '' AS versions
FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits w WHERE w.wait_id = 'CVE-2022-29977|libsixel'
